stench.Name: Stench
stench.Description: When this Pokémon is hit by a melee attack, roll a d10. On a 10, the attacker flinches.

drizzle.Name: Drizzle
drizzle.Description: When this Pokémon enters an outside battle, the weather immediately changes to light rain for 5 rounds.

speed-boost.Name: Speed Boost
speed-boost.Description: This Pokémon's speed is increased by 10 feet while in an environment related to its type (DM discretion).

battle-armor.Name: Battle Armor
battle-armor.Description: This Pokémon gains +2 AC until the end of their next turn if they exclusively use damage dealing moves on their turn.

sturdy.Name: Sturdy
sturdy.Description: When taking damage equal to half or more of your current HP, roll a d4. On a result of 3 or 4, half the damage dealt.

damp.Name: Damp
damp.Description: This Pokémon is unaffected by explosive moves and abilities, and gains two levels of resistance to Fire-type moves. Additionally, non-Water-types with this ability gain STAB with water moves.

limber.Name: Limber
limber.Description: This Pokémon is immune to being paralyzed.

sand-veil.Name: Sand Veil
sand-veil.Description: This Pokémon is immune to Sandstorm damage. In addition, its AC increases by 2 in desert terrain, or during a Sandstorm.

static.Name: Static
static.Description: When this Pokémon is hit byu a melee attack, roll a d4. On a result of 4, the attack takes an amount of electric damage equal to this Pokémon's proficiency bonus.

volt-absorb.Name: Volt Absorb
volt-absorb.Description: This Pokémon takes no damage from electricity or electric-type attacks. Instead, half of any electric damage done is absorbed, restoring the Pokémon's HP.

water-absorb.Name: Water Absorb
water-absorb.Description: This Pokémon takes no damage from water or water-type attacks. Instead, half of any water damage done is absorbed, restoring the Pokémon's HP.

oblivious.Name: Oblivious
oblivious.Description: This Pokémon is immune to moves that attempt to charm or taunt it.

cloud-nine.Name: Cloud Nine
cloud-nine.Description: While this Pokémon is in battle, weather-related abilities have no effect on the Pokémon that have them.

compound-eyes.Name: Compound Eyes
compound-eyes.Description: This Pokémon gets an additional +1 to attack rolls.

insomnia.Name: Insomnia
insomnia.Description: This Pokémon is immune to sleep.

color-change.Name: Color Change
color-change.Description: When hit by a damaging attack, this Pokémon's type changes to the type that hit it. It takes on the new type's resistances, vulnerabilities, and immunities.

immunity.Name: Immunity
immunity.Description: This Pokémon is immune to becoming poisoned.

flash-fire.Name: Flash Fire
flash-fire.Description: This Pokémon takes no damage from fire or fire-type attacks. Instead, immediately after taking a hit from a fire-type move, or in open flames, double the STAB bonus on the next fire-type move.

shield-dust.Name: Shield Dust
shield-dust.Description: Once per long rest, this Pokémon can ignore a negative status condition that results from an enemy move.

own-tempo.Name: Own Tempo
own-tempo.Description: This Pokémon is immune to becoming confused.

suction-cups.Name: Suction Cups
suction-cups.Description: This Pokémon cannot be moved unwillingly. Additionally, when maintaining a grapple, this Pokémon has advantage on all rolls to keep the target grappled.

intimidate.Name: Intimidate
intimidate.Description: Once per short rest, you can impose disadvantage on an enemy attack roll of your choice. You also gain proficiency in Intimidation.

shadow-tag.Name: Shadow Tag
shadow-tag.Description: Creatures within 50 feet of this Pokémon may no flee or switch out, except by item, move, or ability.

rough-skin.Name: Rough Skin
rough-skin.Description: When this Pokémon is hit by a melee attack, it may roll a d4. On a 4, deal an amount of typeless damage equal to its proficiency modifier to its attacker.

wonder-guard.Name: Wonder Guard
wonder-guard.Description: This Pokémon is immune to damaging attacks from types that are not in its vulnerabilities list. Only Shedinja can have this ability. This ability cannot be passed or swapped.

levitate.Name: Levitate
levitate.Description: This Pokémon is immune to ground moves.

effect-spore.Name: Effect Spore
effect-spore.Description: When hit by a melee attack, roll a d4. On a 4, roll another d4. The second d4 can poison, paralyze, confuse, or flinch the attacker.

synchronize.Name: Synchronize
synchronize.Description: If this Pokémon becomes burned, paralyzed, or poisoned, its attacker receives the negative status condition as well (if not immune).

clear-body.Name: Clear Body
clear-body.Description: Other Pokémon's moves or abilities cannot lower this Pokémon's stats.

natural-cure.Name: Natural Cure
natural-cure.Description: Upon gaining a negative status effect, this Pokémon can choose to roll a d4. On a result of 4, this Pokémon is immediately cured.

lightning-rod.Name: Lightning Rod
lightning-rod.Description: If this Pokémon or an ally within 30 feet is targeted with a direct electric-type, damage-dealing move, the Pokémon may use a reaction to nullify the damage dealt to themselves, or halve the damage dealt to an ally.

serene-grace.Name: Serene Grace
serene-grace.Description: The Move DC to pass a saving throw against one of this Pokémon's moves is increased by 1.

swift-swim.Name: Swift Swim
swift-swim.Description: This Pokémon's speed is doubled in rainy conditions.

chlorophyll.Name: Chlorophyll
chlorophyll.Description: This Pokémon's speed is doubled in harsh sunlight.

illuminate.Name: Illuminate
illuminate.Description: This Pokémon knows the Light cantrip and can cast it at will.

trace.Name: Trace
trace.Description: This Pokémon copies a random ability of an opponent when entering battle. The ability cannot be Flower Gift, Forecast, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Trace, Wonder Guard, or Zen Mode.

huge-power.Name: Huge Power
huge-power.Description: Once per short rest, this Pokémon may double the damage dice for a single damage roll. The player must announce that they are using this ability before the attack roll.

poison-point.Name: Poison Point
poison-point.Description: When this Pokémon is hit with a melee attack, roll a d4. On a result of 4, the attacker takes an amount of poison damage equal to thie Pokémon's proficiency modifier.

inner-focus.Name: Inner Focus
inner-focus.Description: This Pokémon is immune to flinching.

magma-armor.Name: Magma Armor
magma-armor.Description: This Pokémon gains +2 AC in harsh sunlight.

water-veil.Name: Water Veil
water-veil.Description: This Pokémon gains +2 AC in rain.

magnet-pull.Name: Magnet Pull
magnet-pull.Description: Steel opponents in battle with this Pokémon have their speeds reduced by half.

soundproof.Name: Soundproof
soundproof.Description: This Pokémon is immune to sound-based moves.

rain-dish.Name: Rain Dish
rain-dish.Description: In rainy conditions, this Pokémon heals for an amount or HP equal to its proficiency bonus at the end of its turns.

sand-stream.Name: Sand Stream
sand-stream.Description: When this Pokémon enters an outside battle, the weather immediately changes to a Sandstorm for 5 rounds.

pressure.Name: Pressure
pressure.Description: Any move targeting this Pokémon directly (non-area of effect moves) doubles the stamina drain on the user when activated.

thick-fat.Name: Thick Fat
thick-fat.Description: This Pokémon takes half the damage it otherwise would from ice and fire damage.

early-bird.Name: Early Bird
early-bird.Description: For a number of times equal to their proficiency modifier per long rest, this Pokémon can choose to use a move with the time of "1 action" as a bonus action instead. Additionally, they have advantage on rolls to wake up from sleep.

flame-body.Name: Flame Body
flame-body.Description: The flames from this Pokémon's body shine dim light in a 15 foot radius. In addition, when hit by a melee attack, roll a d10. On a 10, the attacker is burned. You also gain a single level of resistance to fire-type moves.

run-away.Name: Run Away
run-away.Description: This Pokémon cannot be the target of an attack of opportunity.

keen-eye.Name: Keen Eye
keen-eye.Description: This Pokémon ignores disadvantage when it relates to sight. You also gain proficiency in Perception.

hyper-cutter.Name: Hyper Cutter
hyper-cutter.Description: This Pokémon's attack or damage bonuses cannot be decreased by an opponent's moves.

pickup.Name: Pickup
pickup.Description: If an opponent uses a consumable held item in battle, this Pokémon gains a copy of it if it is not currently holding an item.

truant.Name: Truant
truant.Description: This Pokémon cannot use the same move in back to back rounds.

hustle.Name: Hustle
hustle.Description: When you score a critical hit, you may immediately gain an additional action on your turn. If this action is used to make an attack, you have disadvantage on the roll. You may only ever have one additional action per round.

cute-charm.Name: Cute Charm
cute-charm.Description: Once per short rest, you can impose a flat -5 on an enemy attack roll of your choice as a reaction.

plus.Name: Plus
plus.Description: This Pokémon boosts its attack and damage rolls by 2 if an ally also has the Plus or Minus ability.

minus.Name: Minus
minus.Description: This Pokémon boosts its attack and damage rolls by 2 if an ally also has the Plus or Minus ability.

forecast.Name: Forecast
forecast.Description: This Pokémon changes form with the weather. In rain it becomes water-type, in harsh sunlight it becomes fire-type, in cold and snowy conditions it becomes ice-type. In all other conditions it is normal-type. Its STAB, resistance, immunities, and vulnerabilites change to match the form it takes.

sticky-hold.Name: Sticky Hold
sticky-hold.Description: Held items cannot be stolen or knocked away from this Pokémon. Additionally, when maintaining a grapple, this Pokémon has advantage on all rolls to keep the target grappled.

shed-skin.Name: Shed Skin
shed-skin.Description: If this Pokémon is affected by a negative status ailment, they can roll a d4 at the end of each of thier turns. On a result of 4, they are cured.

guts.Name: Guts
guts.Description: When this Pokémon is burned or poisoned, they are not affected by the negative effects or the condition and they double their MOVE modifier for damage. They still take damage at the end of each of their turns.

marvel-scale.Name: Marvel Scale
marvel-scale.Description: This Pokémon's AC increase by 2 when suffering froma negative status condition.

liquid-ooze.Name: Liquid Ooze
liquid-ooze.Description: If an enemy uses a leeching or absorb move against this Pokémon, the Pokémon must make a CON save against this Pokémon’s CON or become poisoned.

overgrow.Name: Overgrow
overgrow.Description: This Pokémon doubles its STAB bonus when it has 25% or less of its maximum health.

blaze.Name: Blaze
blaze.Description: This Pokémon doubles its STAB bonus when it has 25% or less of its maximum health.

torrent.Name: Torrent
torrent.Description: This Pokémon doubles its STAB bonus when it has 25% or less of its maximum health.

swarm.Name: Swarm
swarm.Description: This Pokémon doubles its STAB bonus when it has 25% or less of its maximum health.

rock-head.Name: Rock Head
rock-head.Description: This Pokémon takes no recoil damage.

drought.Name: Drought
drought.Description: When this Pokémon enters an outside battle, the weather immediately changes to bright sunlight for 5 rounds.

arena-trap.Name: Arena Trap
arena-trap.Description: Grounded creatures within 50 feet of this Pokémon may not flee or switch out, except by item, move, or ability.

vital-spirit.Name: Vital Spirit
vital-spirit.Description: This Pokémon cannot be put to sleep.

white-smoke.Name: White Smoke
white-smoke.Description: Other Pokémon's moves or abilities cannot lower this Pokémon's stats.

pure-power.Name: Pure Power
pure-power.Description: Once per short rest, this Pokémon may double the damage dice for a single damage roll. The player must announce that they are using this ability before the attack roll.

shell-armor.Name: Shell Armor
shell-armor.Description: This Pokémon is immune to extra damage dealt by a critical hit.

air-lock.Name: Air Lock
air-lock.Description: While this Pokémon is in battle, weather-related abilities have no effect on the Pokémon that have them.

tangled-feet.Name: Tangled Feet
tangled-feet.Description: Attacks against this Pokémon have disadvantage when it is confused.

motor-drive.Name: Motor Drive
motor-drive.Description: When hit by an electric-type move, if not immune, this Pokémon's speed increases by 10 feet until the end of combat (up to a max of 50 additional feet).

rivalry.Name: Rivalry
rivalry.Description: This Pokémon adds its proficiency bonus to damage when attacking a Pokémon of the same type.

steadfast.Name: Steadfast
steadfast.Description: Once per long rest, when this Pokémon fails a saving throw against a negative condition, it can choose to pass instead.

snow-cloak.Name: Snow Cloak
snow-cloak.Description: This Pokémon is immune to Hail damage. It's AC is increased by 2 in arctic conditions, or when it is snowing or hailing.

gluttony.Name: Gluttony
gluttony.Description: This Pokémon gains an additional die of healing whenever a healing move restores it.

anger-point.Name: Anger Point
anger-point.Description: After suffering a critical hit, this Pokémon doubles the damage dice for a single move it activates on the following turn.

unburden.Name: Unburden
unburden.Description: While this Pokémon is not holding an item, it gains 10 feet to its speed.

heatproof.Name: Heatproof
heatproof.Description: This Pokémon takes half the damage it otherwise would from fire damage, and is immune to the burning condition.

simple.Name: Simple
simple.Description: Once per short rest, you may double this Pokémon's Move modifier for a single attack or damage roll.

dry-skin.Name: Dry Skin
dry-skin.Description: At the end of each of this Pokémon's turns, it takes an amount of damage equal to its proficiency modifier in harsh sunlight, or heals for the same amount during rain.

download.Name: Download
download.Description: Once per short rest, this Pokémon can choose a different damage type for one of their normal attacks.

iron-fist.Name: Iron Fist
iron-fist.Description: When attacking with a punch-based move, this Pokémon may roll the damage twice and choose either total. Also, this Pokémon may learn any non-exclusive punching move and have an easier time learning them.

poison-heal.Name: Poison Heal
poison-heal.Description: This Pokémon does not suffer the disadvantage effects of the poisoned status. In addition, this Pokémon recovers half of all poison damage it would take, including the damage at each of its turns.

adaptability.Name: Adaptability
adaptability.Description: When this Pokémon uses a move of its own type, it may roll the damage twice and choose either total.

skill-link.Name: Skill Link
skill-link.Description: Combo moves that have the ability to hit more than once, after the same attack roll, are guaranteed to hit at least twice.

hydration.Name: Hydration
hydration.Description: This Pokémon is unaffected by negative status ailments in water or during rainy conditions.

solar-power.Name: Solar Power
solar-power.Description: Damage rolls for this Pokémon get an additional +2 during harsh sunlight.

quick-feet.Name: Quick Feet
quick-feet.Description: When suffering from a negative status condition, this Pokémon's speed increases by 15 feet.

normalize.Name: Normalize
normalize.Description: Every move this Pokémon activates is normal-type.

sniper.Name: Sniper
sniper.Description: On a critical hit made by this Pokémon, triple the dice roll instead of doubling it.

magic-guard.Name: Magic Guard
magic-guard.Description: If this Pokémon is subjected to a move that forces it to make a saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage on a success. Additionally, you do not take indirect damage from weather.

no-guard.Name: No Guard
no-guard.Description: Any attack made by or against this Pokémon has advantage.

stall.Name: Stall
stall.Description: This Pokémon is always last in initiative order.

technician.Name: Technician
technician.Description: For weak, damaging moves activated by this Pokémon, they may add a single additional damage die. (List of moves affected by Technician can be found on Bulbapedia.)

leaf-guard.Name: Leaf Guard
leaf-guard.Description: This Pokémon does not suffer from any negative status ailments in harsh sunlight.

klutz.Name: Klutz
klutz.Description: Once per long rest, this Pokémon can reroll a natural 1. This Pokémon cannot hold an item.

mold-breaker.Name: Mold Breaker
mold-breaker.Description: This Pokémon's moves ignore any abilities that would lessen their effect or ability to hit an opponent.

super-luck.Name: Super Luck
super-luck.Description: This Pokémon increases its critical hit range by 1.

aftermath.Name: Aftermath
aftermath.Description: This Pokémon deals damage to an attacker equal to half of the damage received when knocked out by a melee move.

anticipation.Name: Anticipation
anticipation.Description: This Pokémon can sacrifice its action now to make two attacks on its next turn, or make two attacks now and sacrifice its next action.

forewarn.Name: Forewarn
forewarn.Description: This Pokémon can sacrifice its action now to make two attacks on its next turn, or make two attacks now and sacrifice its next action.

unaware.Name: Unaware
unaware.Description: When this Pokémon attacks an opponent, it ignores any stat boosts the opponent has been affected with after the start of battle. This includes boosts to AC or saving throws the Pokémon has to make.

filter.Name: Filter
filter.Description: When hit by a move type this Pokémon is vulnerable to, it may roll a d4. On a result of 4, it does not take the additional damage.

slow-start.Name: Slow Start
slow-start.Description: This Pokémon's speed is halved and its attacks are made at disadvantage for the first two rounds of every combat.

scrappy.Name: Scrappy
scrappy.Description: This Pokémon's normal and fighting type moves ignore immunities granted by a Pokémon's type. If a target's secondary type gives it vulnerability or resistance to the attack, it follows the secondary type for that effect.

storm-drain.Name: Storm Drain
storm-drain.Description: If this Pokémon or an ally within 30 feet is targeted with a direct water-type, damage-dealing move, the Pokémon may use a reaction to nullify the damage dealt to themselves, or halve the damage dealt to an ally.

ice-body.Name: Ice Body
ice-body.Description: While it is snowing or hailing, this Pokémon heals for an amount of HP equal to its proficiency modifier at the end of each of its turns.

solid-rock.Name: Solid Rock
solid-rock.Description: When hit by a move type this Pokémon is vulnerable to, it may roll a d4. In a result of 4, it does not take the additional damage.

snow-warning.Name: Snow Warning
snow-warning.Description: When this Pokémon enters an outside battle, the weather immediately changes to hail or snow for 5 rounds.

honey-gather.Name: Honey Gather
honey-gather.Description: At the end of each battle, this Pokémon may roll a d20 plus its proficiency bonus. On a result of 20 or higher, its trainer adds a Honey to their inventory.

frisk.Name: Frisk
frisk.Description: Upon entering a battle, a single opponent's held item is revealed, if it has one. You also have an easier time finding good items while traveling.

reckless.Name: Reckless
reckless.Description: When attacking with moves with recoil damage, this Pokémon doubles its STAB bonus.

multitype.Name: Multitype
multitype.Description: This Pokémon's type and form change to match the type of Elemental Plate this Pokémon holds. The Plate cannot be effected by any item-removing ability or move.

flower-gift.Name: Flower Gift
flower-gift.Description: During harsh sunlight, ally Pokémon within 30 feet of this Pokémon add their proficiency bonus to damage rolls.

bad-dreams.Name: Bad Dreams
bad-dreams.Description: If an opponent in battle with this Pokémon falls asleep, they take an amount of damage equal to this Pokémon's proficiency bonus at the end of each of their turns.

pickpocket.Name: Pickpocket
pickpocket.Description: When hit by a melee attack, this Pokémon may use a reaction to attempt to steal the creature's held item with a Sleight of Hand check contested by the target's Passive Perception. After the first attempt, all other attempts against the same opponent are rolled at disadvantage.

sheer-force.Name: Sheer Force
sheer-force.Description: When activating a move that has a chance to impose a stat change or inflict a status, this creature instead doubles its move modifier for the damage with no chance of the additional effect.

contrary.Name: Contrary
contrary.Description: Moves that directly increase or decrease this Pokémon's stats have the opposite effect. For exhaustion, you only gain half of the d20 negative effect. For example, at level 1 exhaustion, you only take +1 instead of -2. This ability has no effect on moves that would "swap" or "average" stats with a target like Heart Swap, Guard Split, etc.

unnerve.Name: Unnerve
unnerve.Description: Opponents in combat with this Pokémon cannot eat berries and have disadvantage on using any healing moves.

defiant.Name: Defiant
defiant.Description: While this Pokémon is suffering from a negative status effect or stat change imposed by an opponent, it gains +2 to all attack rolls. You are not affected by the negative effects of any status condition, but still take any damage from them.

defeatist.Name: Defeatist
defeatist.Description: When this Pokémon drops below 25% of its maximum HP, all of its attacks are rolled with disadvantage.

cursed-body.Name: Cursed Body
cursed-body.Description: When this Pokémon is hit by a melee attack, the opponent who made the attack cannot use the same move until the end of their next turn. This can only trigger once per turn.

healer.Name: Healer
healer.Description: This Pokémon gains +2 healing to all healing moves. Additionally, as an action, this Pokémon may touch a creature to heal poison, burn, or paralysis. When it uses this ability, roll a d4. On a result of 1 or 2, the status effect is moved to itself. You also gain proficiency in Medicine.

friend-guard.Name: Friend Guard
friend-guard.Description: When an ally within 30 feet of this Pokémon is hit by an attack, they may spend their reaction to halve the damage.

weak-armor.Name: Weak Armor
weak-armor.Description: When an attack hits this Pokémon, it’s AC decreases by 1 and it gains advantage on its next attack. The AC change resets after the advantage is used. The advantage applies to moves that require a saving throw.

heavy-metal.Name: Heavy Metal
heavy-metal.Description: This Pokémon is especially heavy. Once per long rest, after being targeted by an attack, it may increase its AC by 2 if it would cause an attack to miss.

light-metal.Name: Light Metal
light-metal.Description: This Pokémon is especially light for its species. Once per long rest, it may impose disadvantage on an attack roll against it.

multiscale.Name: Multiscale
multiscale.Description: If this Pokémon is at full health, the first damage dealt to it is halved.

toxic-boost.Name: Toxic Boost
toxic-boost.Description: When this Pokémon is hit by a poison-type attack, its next attack is rolled at advantage.

flare-boost.Name: Flare Boost
flare-boost.Description: This Pokémon adds proficiency to its damage rolls while burned.

harvest.Name: Harvest
harvest.Description: At the end of this Pokémon's turn, if it used a berry, roll d4. On a result of 3 or 4, it regains that berry as a held item.

telepathy.Name: Telepathy
telepathy.Description: This Pokémon cannot be damaged by its allies' attacks.

moody.Name: Moody
moody.Description: At the end of each long rest, this Pokémon rerolls on the nature table, replacing its nature with the result until the next long rest.

overcoat.Name: Overcoat
overcoat.Description: This Pokémon does not take damage from weather-related moves or phenomena like Hail, Weather Ball, etc.

poison-touch.Name: Poison Touch
poison-touch.Description: On melee attacks made by this Pokémon, roll a d10 on a hit. On a result of a 10, the target is poisoned. You are also immune to the poison status.

regenerator.Name: Regenerator
regenerator.Description: This Pokémon can choose to restore 1d4 + CON at the ends of each of its turns as a free action. At level 10, this increases to 2d4 + CON. After being used 5 turns in a row, the user must take a level of exhaustion.

big-pecks.Name: Big Pecks
big-pecks.Description: This Pokémon's AC cannot be reduced by an opponent's moves.

sand-rush.Name: Sand Rush
sand-rush.Description: This Pokémon is immune to Sandstorm damage, and its speed is doubled in desert terrain, or during a Sandstorm.

wonder-skin.Name: Wonder Skin
wonder-skin.Description: This Pokémon has advantage on all saving throws against being burned, frozen, poisoned, or paralyzed.

analytic.Name: Analytic
analytic.Description: After this Pokémon misses an attack, its next attack is done at advantage.

illusion.Name: Illusion
illusion.Description: This Pokémon can take the visual form of any Pokémon it can see. It can do this a number of times per long rest equal to its level. This illusion lasts for one hour or until the Pokémon is hit by a damaging move.

imposter.Name: Imposter
imposter.Description: This Pokémon can use Transform as a bonus action.

infiltrator.Name: Infiltrator
infiltrator.Description: This Pokémon bypasses Light Screen, Reflect, Substitute, Mist, Safeguard, and Aurora Veil.

mummy.Name: Mummy
mummy.Description: When this Pokémon is hit by a melee attack, all of the abilities of its attacker change to Mummy for the remainder of the encounter.

moxie.Name: Moxie
moxie.Description: Upon causing an opponent to faint, this Pokémon may immediately take another action.

justified.Name: Justified
justified.Description: When this Pokémon is hit by a dark-type move, it gets advantage on its next attack.

rattled.Name: Rattled
rattled.Description: When this Pokémon is hit by a damaging Dark, Bug, or Ghost move, it makes its next attack at advantage.

magic-bounce.Name: Magic Bounce
magic-bounce.Description: A number of times equal to your proficiency modifier per long rest, when you are subjected to a reflectable move, this Pokémon can instead reflect the effect back on the attacker.

sap-sipper.Name: Sap Sipper
sap-sipper.Description: This Pokémon takes no damage from grass-type attacks. If hit by a grass type move, it takes no damage and instead absorbs the energy, granting advantage on its next attack.

prankster.Name: Prankster
prankster.Description: Once per short rest, this Pokémon can move to the top of initiative order in a single round, but must use a status affecting move on its turn.

sand-force.Name: Sand Force
sand-force.Description: During a Sandstorm, this Pokémon can double its STAB when it hits an opponent.

iron-barbs.Name: Iron Barbs
iron-barbs.Description: Each time this Pokémon is hit by an enemy or hits an enemy with a contact move, the opponent takes steel damage equal to half its proficiency modifier, rounded down.

zen-mode.Name: Zen Mode
zen-mode.Description: When Darmanitan is below 50% of its HP, it enters Zen Mode. In Zen Mode, Darmanitan changes into the form of a solid statue. It's type changes to Fire/Psychic, it gains +4 to its AC, and its STR and WIS ability scores are swapped.

victory-star.Name: Victory Star
victory-star.Description: While this Pokémon is in battle, all allied Pokémon add an additional +1 to their attack rolls.

turboblaze.Name: Turboblaze
turboblaze.Description: This Pokémon’s moves completely ignore any ability that would hinder or prevent their effect on the target or the user's ability to hit the target.

teravolt.Name: Teravolt
teravolt.Description: This Pokémon’s moves completely ignore any ability that would hinder or prevent their effect on the target or the user's ability to hit the target.

aroma-veil.Name: Aroma Veil
aroma-veil.Description: Any ally within 15 feet of this Pokémon automatically passes any WIS save they are required to make.

flower-veil.Name: Flower Veil
flower-veil.Description: Any grass-type ally within 15 feet of this Pokémon is immune to new status effects.

cheek-pouch.Name: Cheek Pouch
cheek-pouch.Description: When this Pokémon eats any type of berry, is heals for an additional 10% of its maximum HP (rounded up to the nearest whole number).

protean.Name: Protean
protean.Description: This Pokémon's type changes to the type of move it uses, just before the move is used. It takes on the new type's resistances, vulnerabilities, and immunities.

fur-coat.Name: Fur Coat
fur-coat.Description: Once per long rest, this Pokémon may halve the damage dealt to it from any one attack.

magician.Name: Magician
magician.Description: If not already holding an item, this Pokémon steals the held item of any Pokémon it hits with a melee attack. You also gain a single level in the Wizard class.

bulletproof.Name: Bulletproof
bulletproof.Description: This Pokémon is immune to damage from moves with Bullet, Ball, or Bomb in their name.

competitive.Name: Competitive
competitive.Description: This Pokémon adds its proficiency bonus to damage rolls while poisoned, burned, confused, or paralyzed. You do not take debuffs from being under the effects of the statuses listed, but still take any damage from them.

strong-jaw.Name: Strong Jaw
strong-jaw.Description: For biting moves activated by this Pokémon (Bite, Thunder Fang, Crunch, etc.), they may roll the damage twice and choose either total. Also, this Pokémon may learn any non-exclusive biting move and have an easier time learning them.

refrigerate.Name: Refrigerate
refrigerate.Description: All of this Pokémon's normal-type moves become ice-type.

sweet-veil.Name: Sweet Veil
sweet-veil.Description: Any ally within 15 feet of this Pokémon (including itself) is immune to the sleep condition.

stance-change.Name: Stance Change
stance-change.Description: Aegislash has two forms. When Aegislash uses King's Shield, it changes to Shield Forme, swapping its AC and DEX stats. When it uses a damaging move, Aegislash immediately returns to Blade Forme, returning its stats to normal.

gale-wings.Name: Gale Wings
gale-wings.Description: This Pokémon adds an additional +1 to hit when using flying-type attacks. You may also double your STAB bonus on the first offensive flying-type move you use in combat.

mega-launcher.Name: Mega Launcher
mega-launcher.Description: Aura and Pulse moves made by this Pokémon deal additional damage/healing equal to this Pokémon's proficiency bonus.

grass-pelt.Name: Grass Pelt
grass-pelt.Description: This Pokémon gains +2 to AC while in grassy terrain.

symbiosis.Name: Symbiosis
symbiosis.Description: This Pokémon may swap held items with an ally as a free action if they are within 15 feet. Additionally, they can create a single Oran berry a number of times equal to their WIS or CON modifier, per day.

tough-claws.Name: Tough Claws
tough-claws.Description: A successful melee attack by this Pokémon automatically gets STAB, regardless of its type. If it would normally get STAB, double the STAB bonus when adding to damage.

pixilate.Name: Pixilate
pixilate.Description: All of this Pokémon's normal-type moves become fairy-type.

gooey.Name: Gooey
gooey.Description: When this Pokémon is hit with a melee attack, roll d4. On a result of 3 or 4, the attacker's speed is reduced to 0 until the end of its next turn.

aerilate.Name: Aerilate
aerilate.Description: All of this Pokémon's normal-type moves become flying-type.

dark-aura.Name: Dark Aura
dark-aura.Description: When this Pokémon is in battle, all dark-type moves by allies or opponents within 100 feet deal double their damage.

fairy-aura.Name: Fairy Aura
fairy-aura.Description: When this Pokémon is in battle, all fairy-type moves within 100 feet of you deal double their damage.

aura-break.Name: Aura Break
aura-break.Description: When this Pokémon is in battle, the boost of Fairy Aura and Dark Aura abilities is reversed, Any applicable move type activated within 100 feet deals half damage instead of double.

stamina.Name: Stamina
stamina.Description: When this Pokémon is damaged by a move, increase its AC by 2 until the start of its next turn. This ability does not stack and will remain in effect if the Pokémon is successfully attacked multiple turns in a row.

wimp-out.Name: Wimp Out
wimp-out.Description: When a damaging move causes this Pokémon to fall below 50% of its maximum HP, it MUST disengage and move up to its speed in a straight line towards its trainer as a free action. If this would put the Pokémon in range of switching out, it must do so as another free action if another Pokémon is available to replace it.

emergency-exit.Name: Emergency Exit
emergency-exit.Description: At any time this Pokémon is damaged when it is at or below 50% of its maximum HP, its trainer may switch it out as a free action.

water-compaction.Name: Water Compaction
water-compaction.Description: After being damaged by a water-type move, any other damage dealt to this Pokémon until the beginning of its next turn is halved.

merciless.Name: Merciless
merciless.Description: When this Pokémon makes a successful attack roll against a Poisoned Pokémon, treat that attack as a critical hit.

shields-down.Name: Shields Down
shields-down.Description: This Pokémon is immune to Non-Volatile status effects while in Meteor Form. When this Pokémon falls below 50% of its maximum hp, its outer shell breaks and it changes to Core Form. In Core Form, it adds 6 points to its DEX, but reduces its AC by 4. The Pokémon must complete a short rest to restore itself to Meteor Form.

stakeout.Name: Stakeout
stakeout.Description: When an opponent is switched out in battle, this Pokémon doubles the damage dealt if it targets the replacement on the first turn immediately following the switch.

water-bubble.Name: Water Bubble
water-bubble.Description: This Pokémon is resistant to fire-type damage and immune to the burned condition.

steelworker.Name: Steelworker
steelworker.Description: This Pokémon adds its proficiency bonus to damage dealt by steel-type moves.

berserk.Name: Berserk
berserk.Description: When this Pokémon falls below 25% of its maximum health, all of its attacks are rolled with disadvantage, but deal double their damage. If a move activated requires a saving throw, the target(s) have advantage on the roll.

slush-rush.Name: Slush Rush
slush-rush.Description: This Pokémon is immune to Hail damage, and its speed is doubled in arctic conditions, or during a hailstorm or snowstorm.

long-reach.Name: Long Reach
long-reach.Description: This Pokémon has an additional 5 feet of reach with all melee attacks and attacks of opportunity.

liquid-voice.Name: Liquid Voice
liquid-voice.Description: Any sound-based move activated by this Pokémon is water-type.

triage.Name: Triage
triage.Description: This Pokémon's healing or draining moves have a move time of 1 bonus action. Also, this Pokémon may learn any non-exclusive healing move and have an easier time learning them.

galvanize.Name: Galvanize
galvanize.Description: All of this Pokémon's normal-type moves are electric-type.

surge-surfer.Name: Surge Surfer
surge-surfer.Description: When this Pokémon begins its turn in the area of effect from Electric Terrain, its speed is doubled.

schooling.Name: Schooling
schooling.Description: Beginning at level 5, this Pokémon may change to School Form as a free action when it begins its turn above 25% of its maximum health. In School Form, the Pokémon adds 5 to its AC and Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution ability scores (Additional CON does not alter this Pokémon's HP in this form). The Pokémon reverts back to Solo Form when it falls below 25% of maximum health, and must complete a short rest before activating this ability again.

disguise.Name: Disguise
disguise.Description: This Pokémon has a disguise which gives it a temporary HP boost equal to twice its level. When the temporary hit points fall to zero, the disguise breaks and requires a short rest to repair.

corrosion.Name: Corrosion
corrosion.Description: This Pokémon's moves ignore the poison immunity of creatures granted by their Pokémon type, and can inflict the poisoned status on poison and steel type creatures. If the target’s secondary type gives it vulnerability or resistance to the damage, it follows the secondary type for that effect.

comatose.Name: Comatose
comatose.Description: This Pokémon is in a continuous state of drowsiness. It is immune to the sleep condition, but is considered affected by sleep for all moves that require a Pokémon to be asleep to use or activate additional effects (Snore, Sleep Talk, Wake-Up Slap, Dream Eater, etc.)

queenly-majesty.Name: Queenly Majesty
queenly-majesty.Description: Creatures within line of sight of this Pokémon cannot use bonus actions to activate Moves. Moves that would normally have a Move Time of "1 bonus action" instead have a Move Time of "1 action".

innards-out.Name: Innards Out
innards-out.Description: When this Pokémon is knocked out by a damaging move, any creature within 5 feet of it takes an amount of typeless damage equal to the amount of HP lost.

dancer.Name: Dancer
dancer.Description: If any creature within sight of this Pokémon activates a move with Dance in its name, this Pokémon may immediately use one of its moves as a reaction.

battery.Name: Battery
battery.Description: Allies that activate electric-type moves within 20 feet of this Pokémon double their damage dice.

fluffy.Name: Fluffy
fluffy.Description: This Pokémon is vulnerable to fire-type moves, but takes half damage from any melee attack (that isn't fire-type).

dazzling.Name: Dazzling
dazzling.Description: Creatures within line of sight of this Pokémon cannot use bonus actions to activate Moves. Moves that would normally have a Move Time of "1 bonus action" instead have a Move Time of "1 action".

soul-heart.Name: Soul-Heart
soul-heart.Description: Upon seeing an ally faint, this Pokémon increases the ability scores of its saving throw proficiencies by 2 until the end of combat. This is stackable up to a maximum of +10 to any one ability score.

tangling-hair.Name: Tangling Hair
tangling-hair.Description: When this Pokémon is hit with a melee attack, roll d4. On a result of 3 or 4, the attacker's speed is reduced to 0 until the end of its next turn.

receiver.Name: Receiver
receiver.Description: When switched in after an ally faints, this Pokémon copies the non-hidden ability of the fainted ally until switched out.

power-of-alchemy.Name: Power Of Alchemy
power-of-alchemy.Description: When switched in after an ally faints, this Pokémon copies the non-hidden ability of the fainted ally until switched out.

beast-boost.Name: Beast Boost
beast-boost.Description: Upon causing an opponent to faint, this Pokémon increases the ability scores of its saving throw proficiencies by 2 until the end of combat. This is stackable up to a maximum of +10 to any one ability score.

rks-system.Name: RKS System
rks-system.Description: This Pokémon's type is determined by the memory disc it holds. If not holding a memory disc, this Pokémon's type is normal.

electric-surge.Name: Electric Surge
electric-surge.Description: If the move is known, this Pokémon may use the Electric Terrain move as a bonus action.

psychic-surge.Name: Psychic Surge
psychic-surge.Description: If the move is known, this Pokémon may use the Psychic Terrain move as a bonus action.

misty-surge.Name: Misty Surge
misty-surge.Description: If the move is known, this Pokémon may use the Misty Terrain move as a bonus action.

grassy-surge.Name: Grassy Surge
grassy-surge.Description: If the move is known, this Pokémon may use the Grassy Terrain move as a bonus action.

full-metal-body.Name: Full Metal Body
full-metal-body.Description: Other Pokémon's moves or abilities cannot lower this Pokémon stats.

shadow-shield.Name: Shadow Shield
shadow-shield.Description: If this Pokémon is at full health, the first damage dealt to it is halved.

prism-armor.Name: Prism Armor
prism-armor.Description: When this Pokémon is subject to damage in its vulnerabilities list, roll the damage dice twice and use the lower result for the damage calculation.

neuroforce.Name: Neuroforce
neuroforce.Description: When this Pokémon damages a creature with a super effective move, it may roll the damage dice twice and use the higher result.

libero.Name: Libero
libero.Description: This Pokémon's type changes to the type of move it uses, just before the move is used. It takes on the new type's resistances, vulnerabilities, and immunities.

ball-fetch.Name: Ball Fetch
ball-fetch.Description: The trainer has advantage on any rolls related to throwing a Pokéball.

cotton-down.Name: Cotton Down
cotton-down.Description: When this Pokémon is hit with a melee attack, roll d4. On a result of 3 or 4, the attacker's speed is reduced to 0 until the end of its next turn.

propeller-tail.Name: Propeller Tail
propeller-tail.Description: If the user swims half of it's base movement speed or more immediately before a melee attack it adds one additional damage dice to the attack (this can only be used for 1 action per turn).

mirror-armor.Name: Mirror Armor
mirror-armor.Description: If an opponent tries to use a status lowering move on this Pokémon. This Pokémon can reflect the effect back at the opponent a number of times equal to its proficiency bonus.

gulp-missile.Name: Gulp Missile
gulp-missile.Description: Three times per long rest, this Pokémon can vomit a projectile at an opponent within 20 ft. Lower the opponent’s AC by 2.

stalwart.Name: Stalwart
stalwart.Description: Once per long rest, after an opponent knocks you out, you may attack them with any one of your moves right before you go down at the cost of a addition level of exhaustion when you are revived.

steam-engine.Name: Steam Engine
steam-engine.Description: When this Pokémon is hit by a water or fire type attack, increase it’s movement speed by 20 ft.

punk-rock.Name: Punk Rock
punk-rock.Description: For sound-based moves activated by this Pokémon (Hyper Voice, Echoed Voice, Boomburst, etc.), they may roll the damage twice and choose either total. Furthermore, you are able to learn any non-exclusive sound-based move that could be affected by this ability, and they are easier to learn. Lastly, this Pokemon can take half damage from any sound based move used against it.

sand-spit.Name: Sand Spit
sand-spit.Description: When hit by an attack, this Pokémon can use Sand Attack as a reaction.

ice-scales.Name: Ice Scales
ice-scales.Description: Once per long rest take half damage from a ranged move of your choice.

ripen.Name: Ripen
ripen.Description: When this Pokémon consumes a berry, the effects of the berry is doubled. Berry trees that are visited by this Pokémon ripen quicker.

ice-face.Name: Ice Face
ice-face.Description: When this Pokémon is hit for the first time in battle by a melee attack, instead of taking damage, it’s ice armor breaks. When this happens, it’s AC goes down by 4, it’s speed increases by 20 feet, and it’s Dexterity increases by 4. It then needs to recraft the ice face.

power-spot.Name: Power Spot
power-spot.Description: This Pokémon shares it's aura with its allies. Allies within thirty feet of this Pokémon may add +1 to their attack and damage rolls.

mimicry.Name: Mimicry
mimicry.Description: This Pokémon changes type based on the terrain of the battlefield.

screen-cleaner.Name: Screen Cleaner
screen-cleaner.Description: A number of times equal to this Pokemon’s proficiency bonus you may force a Pokemon trying to use Reflect, Light Screen, or Aurora Veil into failing.

steely-spirit.Name: Steely Spirit
steely-spirit.Description: This Pokemn grants its allies advantage on all their attack rolls for their steel type moves.

perish-body.Name: Perish Body
perish-body.Description: When this Pokémon is hit by a melee attack, roll a D20. On a natural 20, the Pokémon that hit them will faint in 3 rounds. Withdrawing the Pokémon effected pauses but does not erase this effect, with the effect fading away naturally in 24 hours.

wandering-spirit.Name: Wandering Spirit
wandering-spirit.Description: When this Pokémon is hit by a melee attack, roll a d3. Depending on the roll, this Pokemon gains one of the abilities of its attacker for the remainder of the encounter.

gorilla-tactics.Name: Gorilla Tactics
gorilla-tactics.Description: Grants advantage on attack rolls for one minute, but only allows use of one move.

neutralizing-gas.Name: Neutralizing Gas
neutralizing-gas.Description: Pokémon cannot activate their abilities while this Pokémon is on the battlefield.

pastel-veil.Name: Pastel Veil
pastel-veil.Description: This Pokémon grants itself and teammates immunity from being poisoned, and it cures the poison status when this Pokémon enters the battlefield.

hunger-switch.Name: Hunger Switch
hunger-switch.Description: Once per long rest, this Pokémon may double the damage of one of its moves. If it does so it gains an exhaustion counter and switches to Hangry Mode. If it uses this ability when using Aura wheel, triple the damage instead.

quick-draw.Name: Quick Draw
quick-draw.Description: Once per short rest, this Pokémon can move to the top of initiative order in a single round, but must use a ranged attack on its turn.

unseen-fist.Name: Unseen Fist
unseen-fist.Description: This Pokemon's melee attacks ignore the damage protection from moves like Protect or Light Screen. If the opponent has mastered their damage reduction move, the damage is halved instead of nullified regardless of the level of mastery of the move.

curious-medicine.Name: Curious Medicine
curious-medicine.Description: When this Pokémon enters the battlefield, it scatters a medicine that removes negative effects from allies as well as healing its allies by 1d6 + INT Modifier.

lingering-aroma.Name: Lingering Aroma
lingering-aroma.Description:
Male: When this Pokémon is hit by a melee attack, all of the abilities of its attacker change to Lingering Aroma for the remainder of the encounter.

Female: Any ally within 15 feet of this Pokémon automatically passes any WIS save they are required to make.

seed-sower.Name: Seed Sower
seed-sower.Description: This Pokemon gains a level of mastery for the move Grassy Terrain immediately upon evolution.

thermal-exchange.Name: Thermal Exchange
thermal-exchange.Description: This pokemon is immune to the burn status condition. In addition, they gain +1 to attack rolls when hit by a fire-type move until withdrawn from combat. This bonus can stack to a maximun of +5.

anger-shell.Name: Anger Shell
anger-shell.Description: When this Pokemon is below half health, immediately apply the effects of Shell Smash to it.

purifying-salt.Name: Purifying Salt
purifying-salt.Description: This Pokemon cannot be inflicted with a negative status condition, and it gains one level of resistance to ghost-type attacks.

well-baked-body.Name: Well-Baked Body
well-baked-body.Description: This Pokémon takes no damage from fire or fire-type attacks. Instead, immediately after taking a hit from a fire-type move, or in open flames, increase this Pokemon’s AC by 2. This AC bonus is not stackable.

wind-rider.Name: Wind Rider
wind-rider.Description: This Pokemon has immunity to taking damage from wind-based moves. Also, if it is hit by a wind-based move (or tailwind or sandstorm is active) then it gains +1 to its attack rolls. This effect is stackable to +5.

guard-dog.Name: Guard Dog
guard-dog.Description: This Pokemon gains the Sentinel feat.

rocky-payload.Name: Rocky Payload
rocky-payload.Description: When this pokemon uses a rock type move while in the air, roll damage twice and take the higher value.

wind-power.Name: Wind Power
wind-power.Description: This Pokémon becomes charged when it is hit by a wind move, or when Tailwind/Sandstorm begins, doubling the user’s STAB bonus.

zero-to-hero.Name: Zero To Hero
zero-to-hero.Description:
When your Loyalty Bond is at +2 or above with your Palafin, you can trigger a powerful but tiring transformation. The Palafin must succeed a DC 20 Stealth check in order for the transformation to activate, or be recalled into their Pokeball for 30 seconds before being returned to battle.

While in their Hero form the Palafin's STAB bonus is doubled, it gains +20 ft to swimming speed, gains 20 ft walking speed, and gains Temporary Hit Points equal to: 5x Base CON Modifier.

Also, it gains +3 to AC, +2 to its Strength modifier, and +1 to all of its of its other ability modifiers. You may choose to double Palafin’s base move modifier attack rolls, double the base modifier for damage rolls, or you can add +1 to all of its saving throws. This transformation lasts for one minute and when ended, Palafin gains two levels of exhaustion.

commander.Name: Commander
commander.Description: This Pokémon can use the Help action as a free action for an ally Dondozo within 5 feet. Also, the Dondozo supported by this ability cannot be forcefully moved from its position.

electromorphosis.Name: Electromorphosis
electromorphosis.Description: When this Pokemon is hit by an attack, you may roll an additional damage dice for its next electric attack.

protosynthesis.Name: Protosynthesis
protosynthesis.Description: During harsh sunlight, this Pokémon adds two ASI to its highest, non-CON stat.

quark-drive.Name: Quark Drive
quark-drive.Description: When electric terrain is active, this Pokémon adds two ASI points to its highest, non-CON stat.

good-as-gold.Name: Good As Gold
good-as-gold.Description: This Pokémon cannot be inflicted with a negative status condition.

opportunist.Name: Opportunist
opportunist.Description: If an opponent's stat is boosted, the Pokémon seizes the opportunity to boost the same stat for itself.

cud-chew.Name: Cud Chew
cud-chew.Description: This Pokémon can re-eat a berry they had eaten before the battle, allowing it to make use of held berries in regulated battles. In unregulated battles, they may eat it twice.

sharpness.Name: Sharpness
sharpness.Description: For damaging moves activated by this Pokémon with a slashing aspect (i.e. Leaf Blade, Psycho Cut, etc.), they may roll the damage twice and choose either total. Also, this Pokémon may learn any non-exclusive slashing move and have an easier time learning them.

supreme-overlord.Name: Supreme Overlord
supreme-overlord.Description: For each fainted Pokémon in the same party, this Pokémon lowers the natural dice needed for a critical hit by 1 (to a max of nat 15 for critical hits).

costar.Name: Costar
costar.Description: If an ally uses a stat buffing move while you are on the field, you may spend your reaction to also use that move.

toxic-debris.Name: Toxic Debris
toxic-debris.Description: This Pokémon has inborn knowledge/mastery over the move Toxic Spikes. Pokémon with this ability will have know Toxic Spikes as a free egg move if hatched from an egg. Wild Pokémon with this ability start with some level of mastery of the move.

armor-tail.Name: Armor Tail
armor-tail.Description: Before this Pokémon's first turn in battle, it can use its reaction to prevent a Pokémon from performing a move on itself or one of its allies.

earth-eater.Name: Earth Eater
earth-eater.Description: This Pokémon takes no damage from ground-type attacks. Instead, heal the user by the half of the amount of damage you would have taken.

mycelium-might.Name: Mycelium Might
mycelium-might.Description: This Pokémon has mastery in one status inflicting move. It’s status inflicting moves can ignore abilities if the Pokémon has not used it’s movement speed this turn.

supersweet-syrup.Name: Supersweet Syrup
supersweet-syrup.Description: Once per long rest this Pokemon can lower an opponent’s AC by 3 for the rest of combat.

hospitality.Name: Hospitality
hospitality.Description: This Pokémon can choose to restore the HP of an ally within 50 feet by 1d4 + CON modifier at the ends of each of its turns as a free action. At level 10, this increases to 2d4 + CON modifier. After being used 5 times, the user must take a level of exhaustion.
